mapper.insert: insert into city_fairness_outing (member_id, instance_id, board_id, region_id, season_id, rules_release_id, release_id, content_hash) select accepted_by, id, board_id, region_id, season_id, rules_release_id, release_id, content_hash from city_onsite_task_instance where id = #{instanceId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and accepted_by = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select id, member_id as memberId, instance_id as instanceId, board_id as boardId, region_id as regionId, season_id as seasonId, rules_release_id as rulesReleaseId, release_id as releaseId, content_hash as contentHash from city_fairness_outing where instance_id = #{instanceId}
mapper.insert: insert into city_fairness_source_receipt (source_ref, event_id, received_at) values (#{sourceRef}, #{eventId}, #{receivedAt})
